DEPARTMENT OF COMMERCE

International Trade Administration

[A-570-106]


Wooden Cabinets and Vanities and Components Thereof From the 
People's Republic of China: Final Results of Antidumping Duty 
Administrative Review, 2024-2025

AGENCY: Enforcement and Compliance, International Trade Administration, 
Department of Commerce.

SUMMARY: The U.S. Department of Commerce (Commerce) determines that 
certain exporters of wooden cabinets and vanities and components 
thereof (wooden cabinets and vanities) from the People's Republic of 
China (China), made sales of subject merchandise at less than normal 
value (NV) during the period of review (POR) April 1, 2024, through 
March 31, 2025.

DATES: Applicable November 12, 2026.

[Individual contact details excluded.]

SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION:

Background

    On July 13, 2026, Commerce published the Preliminary Results of 
this review in the Federal Register and invited interested parties to 
comment.\1\ For a complete description of the events since the 
Preliminary Results, see the Issues and Decision Memorandum.\2\ The 
Issues and Decision Memorandum is a public document and is on file 
electronically via Enforcement and Compliance's Antidumping and 
Countervailing Duty Centralized Electronic Service System (ACCESS). 
ACCESS is available to registered users at https://access.trade.gov. In 
addition, a complete version of the Issues and Decision Memorandum can 
be accessed directly at https://access.trade.gov/frnotices.
---------------------------------------------------------------------------

    \1\ See Wooden Cabinets and Vanities and Components Thereof from 
the People's Republic of China: Preliminary Results and Partial 
Recission of the Antidumping Duty Administrative Review; 2024-2025, 
91 FR 42922 (July 13, 2026) (Preliminary Results), and accompanying 
Preliminary Decision Memorandum (PDM).
    \2\ See Memorandum, ``Issues and Decision Memorandum for the 
Final Results of the Administrative Review of the Antidumping Duty 
Order on Wooden Cabinets and Vanities and Components Thereof from 
the People's Republic of China; 2024-2025,'' dated concurrently 
with, and hereby adopted by, this notice (Issues and Decision 
Memorandum).
---------------------------------------------------------------------------

    Commerce conducted this administrative review in accordance with 
section 751(a)(1)(B) of the Tariff Act of 1930, as amended (the Act).

Scope of the Order 3
---------------------------------------------------------------------------

    \3\ See Wooden Cabinets and Vanities and Components Thereof from 
the People's Republic of China: Antidumping Duty Order, 85 FR 22126 
(April 21, 2020) (Order).
---------------------------------------------------------------------------

    The products covered by the Order are wooden cabinets and vanities 
from China. A complete description of the scope of the Order is 
contained in the Issues and Decision Memorandum.

Analysis of a Comment Received

    An issue raised in the case brief by Yixing Pengjia Technology Co., 
Ltd. (Pengjia Technology) in this administrative review is addressed in 
the Issues and Decision Memorandum and is listed in the appendix to 
this notice.

Changes Since the Preliminary Results

    Based on our review of the record and the comments received from 
Pengjia Technology regarding the Preliminary Results, and for the 
reasons explained in the Issues and Decision Memorandum, we did not 
make changes to the margin calculation for Pengjia Technology.\4\
---------------------------------------------------------------------------

    \4\ See Issues and Decision Memorandum.
---------------------------------------------------------------------------

Rate for Non-Examined Separate Rate Respondents

    No party commented on Commerce's preliminary decision to grant a 
separate rate to Jiangsu Xiangsheng Bedtime Furniture Co., Ltd., Xiamen 
Golden Huanan Imp. & Exp. Co., Ltd., and Zhongshan NU Furniture Co., 
Ltd.\5\ We have made no changes to Commerce's preliminary separate rate 
determination for the final results of review.
---------------------------------------------------------------------------

    \5\ See Preliminary Results.
---------------------------------------------------------------------------

Final Results of Review

    Commerce determines that the following estimated weighted-average 
dumping margins exist for the period April 1, 2024, through March 31, 
2025:

------------------------------------------------------------------------
                                                     Weighted-average
                    Exporter                          dumping margin
                                                        (percent)
------------------------------------------------------------------------
Yixing Pengjia Technology Co., Ltd.............                     7.48
------------------------------------------------------------------------

Non-Individually Examined Companies Receiving a Separate Rate
------------------------------------------------------------------------
Jiangsu Xiangsheng Bedtime Furniture Co., Ltd..                     7.48
Xiamen Golden Huanan Imp. & Exp. Co., Ltd......                     7.48
Zhongshan NU Furniture Co., Ltd................                     7.48
------------------------------------------------------------------------

Disclosure

    Normally, Commerce discloses to interested parties the calculations 
performed in connection with the final results within five days of its 
public announcement or, if there is no public announcement, within five 
days of the date of publication of this notice in accordance with 19 
CFR 351.224(b). However, because Commerce made no changes to the 
calculations from the Preliminary Results, there are no calculations to 
disclose to interested parties in accordance with 19 CFR 351.224(b).

Assessment Rates

    Pursuant to section 751(a)(2)(C) of the Act, and 19 CFR 
351.212(b)(1), Commerce has determined, and U.S. Customs and Border 
Protection (CBP) shall assess, antidumping duties on all appropriate 
entries of subject merchandise in accordance with the final results of 
this review. Pursuant to 19 CFR 351.212(b)(1), for Pengjia Technology, 
we calculated importer-specific ad valorem duty assessment rate based 
on the ratio of the total amount of dumping calculated for each 
importer's examined sales and the total entered value of the sales in 
accordance with 19 CFR 351.212(b)(1). Where an importer-specific 
assessment rate is zero or de minimis, i.e., less than 0.5 percent, the 
entries by that importer will be liquidated without regard to 
antidumping duties.
    For the respondents that were not selected for individual 
examination in this administrative review but qualified for a separate 
rate, the assessment rate will be equal to the weighted-average dumping 
margins calculated for the mandatory respondents, i.e., Pengjia 
Technology, consistent with section 735(c)(5)(A) of the Act. 
Consequently, the rate established for the non-individually examined 
companies is an ad valorem rate of 7.48 percent. For entries of subject 
merchandise during the POR produced by Pengjia Technology for which it 
did not know its merchandise was destined for the United States, we 
intend to instruct CBP to liquidate such entries at the China-wide rate 
if there is no rate for the intermediate company or companies involved 
in the transaction.
    Commerce intends to issue assessment instructions to CBP no earlier 
than 35 days after the date of publication of the final results of this 
review in the Federal Register. If a timely summons is filed at the 
U.S. Court of International Trade, the assessment instructions will 
direct CBP not to liquidate relevant entries until the time for parties 
to file a request for a statutory injunction has expired, i.e., within 
90 days of publication.

Cash Deposit Requirements

    Upon publication of this notice in the Federal Register, the 
following cash deposit requirements will be effective for all shipments 
of the subject merchandise entered, or withdrawn from warehouse, for 
consumption on or after the publication date of the final results of 
this administrative review, as provided in section 751(a)(2)(C) of the 
Act: (1) the cash deposit rates for the companies subject to this 
review will be the rates established in these final results of the 
review; (2) for previously investigated or reviewed Chinese and non-
Chinese exporters not listed above that have separate rates, the cash 
deposit rate will continue to be the exporter-specific rate published 
for the most recently completed segment of this proceeding in which 
they were reviewed; (3) for all Chinese exporters of subject 
merchandise that have not been found to be entitled to a separate rate, 
the cash deposit rate will be equal to the rate for the China-wide 
entity (i.e., 251.64 percent); \6\ and (4) for all non-Chinese 
exporters of subject merchandise which have not received their own 
separate rate, the cash deposit rate will be the rate applicable to the 
Chinese exporter(s) that supplied that non-Chinese exporter. These cash 
deposit requirements, when imposed, shall remain in effect until 
further notice.
---------------------------------------------------------------------------

    \6\ See Order, 85 FR at 22132.
---------------------------------------------------------------------------

Notification to Importers

    This notice serves as a final reminder to importers of their 
responsibility under 19 CFR 351.402(f)(2) to file a certificate 
regarding the reimbursement of antidumping and/or countervailing duties 
prior to liquidation of the relevant entries during this POR. Failure 
to comply with this requirement could result in Commerce's presumption 
that reimbursement of antidumping and/or countervailing duties has 
occurred and the subsequent assessment of double antidumping duties, 
and/or an increase in the amount of antidumping duties by the amount of 
countervailing duties.

Administrative Protective Order

    This notice also serves as a final reminder to parties subject to 
an administrative protective order (APO) of their responsibility 
concerning the return or destruction of proprietary information 
disclosed under APO in accordance with 19 CFR 351.305(a)(3), which 
continues to govern business proprietary information in this segment of 
the proceeding. Timely written notification of the return or 
destruction of APO materials, or conversion to judicial protective 
order, is hereby requested. Failure to comply with the regulations and 
the terms of an APO is a sanctionable violation.

Notification to Interested Parties

    These final results are issued and published in accordance with 
sections 751(a)(1) and 777(i)(1) of the Act and 19 CFR 351.221(b)(5).

    Dated: November 6, 2026.
Steven Presing,
Executive Director for Policy and Negotiations.

Appendix

List of Topics Discussed in the Issues and Decision Memorandum

I. Summary
II. Background
III. Scope of the Order
IV. Discussion of the Issue
    Comment: Financial Statements of Orma Orman Mahsulleri Integre 
A.[Scedil].
V. Recommendation

商務省 国際貿易局 執行・コンプライアンス部門［A-570-106］
中国産の木製キャビネット、洗面化粧台およびその部品に関する反ダンピング税の行政審査（2024～2025年）の最終結果

概要。米商務省は、2024年4月1日～2025年3月31日の審査対象期間に、中国の一部輸出業者が対象品を正常価額を下回って販売したと認定した。適用日は2026年11月12日。

背景。2026年7月13日、商務省は官報に暫定結果を掲載し、利害関係者の意見を求めた［1］。その後の経緯は論点・決定覚書［2］に記載する。同覚書は公開文書で、反ダンピング・相殺関税の集中電子サービスシステム（ACCESS）に収録されている。登録利用者は https://access.trade.gov から利用でき、完全版は https://access.trade.gov/frnotices でも直接閲覧できる。
［1］暫定結果・審査の一部取り消し、91 FR 42922（2026年7月13日）、および付随する暫定決定覚書。
［2］本告示と同日付の「中国産木製キャビネット、洗面化粧台およびその部品に対する反ダンピング税命令の行政審査最終結果の論点・決定覚書（2024～2025年）」。本告示で採用。

商務省は改正1930年関税法第751条(a)(1)(B)に基づき審査した。

命令の対象［3］。中国産木製キャビネットと洗面化粧台。対象範囲の完全な記述は論点・決定覚書にある。
［3］反ダンピング税命令、85 FR 22126（2020年4月21日）。

提出意見。Yixing Pengjia Technology Co., Ltd.が意見書で挙げた論点を覚書で扱い、告示の付録に示す。
暫定結果からの変更。記録および同社の意見を検討し、覚書に記載の理由により、同社のマージン計算は変更しなかった［4］。
［4］論点・決定覚書参照。

個別審査を行わなかった企業の個別税率。Jiangsu Xiangsheng Bedtime Furniture Co., Ltd.、Xiamen Golden Huanan Imp. & Exp. Co., Ltd.、Zhongshan NU Furniture Co., Ltd.に個別税率を認める暫定決定に意見はなく、最終結果でも変更しなかった［5］。
［5］暫定結果参照。

最終結果。2024年4月1日～2025年3月31日の推計加重平均ダンピングマージン。

| 輸出業者 | マージン |
| --- | ---: |
| Yixing Pengjia Technology Co., Ltd. | 7.48％ |

| 個別審査を行わず個別税率を認めた輸出業者 | マージン |
| --- | ---: |
| Jiangsu Xiangsheng Bedtime Furniture Co., Ltd. | 7.48％ |
| Xiamen Golden Huanan Imp. & Exp. Co., Ltd. | 7.48％ |
| Zhongshan NU Furniture Co., Ltd. | 7.48％ |

開示。通常、19 CFR 351.224(b)に従い公表から5日以内、公表がなければ告示の官報掲載から5日以内に最終結果の計算を開示する。暫定結果から計算を変更していないため、今回同条に基づき開示する計算はない。

賦課率。関税法第751条(a)(2)(C)と19 CFR 351.212(b)(1)に従い、商務省が決定し、米税関・国境警備局（CBP）が対象貨物の該当輸入申告に反ダンピング税を賦課する。Pengjia Technologyについては、各輸入業者の審査対象販売で計算したダンピング額の合計を当該販売の申告価額合計で割り、業者別従価賦課率を算出した。ゼロまたは僅少（0.5％未満）なら、当該輸入業者の申告を反ダンピング税なしで精算する。
個別審査を行わず個別税率を認めた企業の賦課率は、同法第735条(c)(5)(A)に沿い、審査対象のPengjia Technologyの加重平均マージンと等しく、従価7.48％。審査対象期間に同社が生産し、米国向けと知らなかった貨物は、介在企業に税率がなければ中国全体の税率で精算するようCBPに指示する予定。
最終結果の官報掲載から35日より前にはCBPへ賦課指示を出さない予定。米国国際貿易裁判所への召喚状が期限内に提出された場合は、法定差止命令を請求できる期間（掲載から90日以内）が満了するまで該当申告を精算しないよう指示する。

現金保証金。関税法第751条(a)(2)(C)に従い、最終結果の掲載日以降に消費目的で輸入申告または保税倉庫から引き取られる対象貨物に以下を適用する。(1) 今回の審査対象企業は最終結果の税率。(2) 表にない、調査・審査済みで個別税率を持つ中国内外の輸出業者は、該当業者について直近の手続で公表した固有税率を維持。(3) 個別税率を認められない中国の輸出業者は中国全体の251.64％［6］。(4) 固有の個別税率を持たない中国外の輸出業者には、当該業者に供給した中国輸出業者の税率。適用した保証金要件は別途通知まで有効。
［6］命令、85 FR 22132頁参照。

輸入業者への通知。19 CFR 351.402(f)(2)に基づき、審査期間中の該当申告の精算前に反ダンピング税・相殺関税の補填に関する証明書を提出する責任を最終通知する。従わなければ補填があったと推定され、反ダンピング税が倍額になり、または相殺関税額に応じて反ダンピング税が増額され得る。

行政保護命令（APO）。19 CFR 351.305(a)(3)に従い、APOで開示された専有情報の返却・破棄の責任を最終通知する。本手続の営業秘密情報に同条が引き続き適用される。返却・破棄または司法保護命令への移行を速やかに書面で通知することを求める。不履行は制裁の対象となる違反。

利害関係者への通知。関税法第751条(a)(1)・第777条(i)(1)と19 CFR 351.221(b)(5)に従い発出・掲載する。2026年11月6日付。政策・交渉担当執行部長 スティーブン・プレシング。

付録。論点・決定覚書の項目。I. 要約、II. 背景、III. 命令の範囲、IV. 論点の検討（Orma Orman Mahsulleri Integre A.Ş.の財務諸表）、V. 勧告。
［官報文書2026-23045、11月10日08:45提出］請求コード 3510-DS-P。
facts_ja: 商務省は中国産木製キャビネット・洗面化粧台等の審査で4社の推計加重平均ダンピングマージンを7.48％に確定。暫定結果の計算は変更していない。
個別税率を持たない中国輸出業者の現金保証金率は既存の中国全体税率251.64％。11月12日適用と明記。
inference_ja: 特定製品・業者への適用。輸入数量・調達先変更・小売価格を確認するまで、米物価全体への波及は判定できない。

public announcement or, if there is no public announcement, within five 
days of the date of publication of this notice in accordance with 19 
CFR 351.224(b). However, because Commerce made no changes to the 
calculations from the Preliminary Results, there are no calculations to 
disclose to interested parties in accordance with 19 CFR 351.224(b).

Assessment Rates

    Pursuant to section 751(a)(2)(C) of the Act, and 19 CFR 
351.212(b)(1), Commerce has determined, and U.S. Customs and Border 
Protection (CBP) shall assess, antidumping duties on all appropriate 
entries of subject merchandise in accordance with the final results of 
this review. Pursuant to 19 CFR 351.212(b)(1), for Pengjia Technology, 
we calculated importer-specific ad valorem duty assessment rate based 
on the ratio of the total amount of dumping calculated for each 
importer's examined sales and the total entered value of the sales in 
accordance with 19 CFR 351.212(b)(1). Where an importer-specific 
assessment rate is zero or de minimis, i.e., less than 0.5 percent, the 
entries by that importer will be liquidated without regard to 
antidumping duties.
    For the respondents that were not selected for individual 
examination in this administrative review but qualified for a separate 
rate, the assessment rate will be equal to the weighted-average dumping 
margins calculated for the mandatory respondents, i.e., Pengjia 
Technology, consistent with section 735(c)(5)(A) of the Act. 
Consequently, the rate established for the non-individually examined 
companies is an ad valorem rate of 7.48 percent. For entries of subject 
merchandise during the POR produced by Pengjia Technology for which it 
did not know its merchandise was destined for the United States, we 
intend to instruct CBP to liquidate such entries at the China-wide rate 
if there is no rate for the intermediate company or companies involved 
in the transaction.
    Commerce intends to issue assessment instructions to CBP no earlier 
than 35 days after the date of publication of the final results of this 
review in the Federal Register. If a timely summons is filed at the 
U.S. Court of International Trade, the assessment instructions will 
direct CBP not to liquidate relevant entries until the time for parties 
to file a request for a statutory injunction has expired, i.e., within 
90 days of publication.

Cash Deposit Requirements

    Upon publication of this notice in the Federal Register, the 
following cash deposit requirements will be effective for all shipments 
of the subject merchandise entered, or withdrawn from warehouse, for 
consumption on or after the publication date of the final results of 
this administrative review, as provided in section 751(a)(2)(C) of the 
Act: (1) the cash deposit rates for the companies subject to this 
review will be the rates established in these final results of the 
review; (2) for previously investigated or reviewed Chinese and non-
Chinese exporters not listed above that have separate rates, the cash 
deposit rate will continue to be the exporter-specific rate published 
for the most recently completed segment of this proceeding in which 
they were reviewed; (3) for all Chinese exporters of subject 
merchandise that have not been found to be entitled to a separate rate, 
the cash deposit rate will be equal to the rate for the China-wide 
entity (i.e., 251.64 percent); \6\ and (4) for all non-Chinese 
exporters of subject merchandise which have not received their own 
separate rate, the cash deposit rate will be the rate applicable to the 
Chinese exporter(s) that supplied that non-Chinese exporter. These cash 
deposit requirements, when imposed, shall remain in effect until 
further notice.
---------------------------------------------------------------------------

    \6\ See Order, 85 FR at 22132.
---------------------------------------------------------------------------

Notification to Importers

    This notice serves as a final reminder to importers of their 
responsibility under 19 CFR 351.402(f)(2) to file a certificate 
regarding the reimbursement of antidumping and/or countervailing duties 
prior to liquidation of the relevant entries during this POR. Failure 
to comply with this requirement could result in Commerce's presumption 
that reimbursement of antidumping and/or countervailing duties has 
occurred and the subsequent assessment of double antidumping duties, 
and/or an increase in the amount of antidumping duties by the amount of 
countervailing duties.

Administrative Protective Order

    This notice also serves as a final reminder to parties subject to 
an administrative protective order (APO) of their responsibility 
concerning the return or destruction of proprietary information 
disclosed under APO in accordance with 19 CFR 351.305(a)(3), which 
continues to govern business proprietary information in this segment of 
the proceeding. Timely written notification of the return or 
destruction of APO materials, or conversion to judicial protective 
order, is hereby requested. Failure to comply with the regulations and 
the terms of an APO is a sanctionable violation.

Notification to Interested Parties

    These final results are issued and published in accordance with 
sections 751(a)(1) and 777(i)(1) of the Act and 19 CFR 351.221(b)(5).

    Dated: November 6, 2026.
Steven Presing,
Executive Director for Policy and Negotiations.

開示。通常、19 CFR 351.224(b)に従い公表から5日以内、公表がなければ告示の官報掲載から5日以内に最終結果の計算を開示する。暫定結果から計算を変更していないため、今回同条に基づき開示する計算はない。

賦課率。関税法第751条(a)(2)(C)と19 CFR 351.212(b)(1)に従い、商務省が決定し、米税関・国境警備局（CBP）が対象貨物の該当輸入申告に反ダンピング税を賦課する。Pengjia Technologyについては、各輸入業者の審査対象販売で計算したダンピング額の合計を当該販売の申告価額合計で割り、業者別従価賦課率を算出した。ゼロまたは僅少（0.5％未満）なら、当該輸入業者の申告を反ダンピング税なしで精算する。
個別審査を行わず個別税率を認めた企業の賦課率は、同法第735条(c)(5)(A)に沿い、審査対象のPengjia Technologyの加重平均マージンと等しく、従価7.48％。審査対象期間に同社が生産し、米国向けと知らなかった貨物は、介在企業に税率がなければ中国全体の税率で精算するようCBPに指示する予定。
最終結果の官報掲載から35日より前にはCBPへ賦課指示を出さない予定。米国国際貿易裁判所への召喚状が期限内に提出された場合は、法定差止命令を請求できる期間（掲載から90日以内）が満了するまで該当申告を精算しないよう指示する。

現金保証金。関税法第751条(a)(2)(C)に従い、最終結果の掲載日以降に消費目的で輸入申告または保税倉庫から引き取られる対象貨物に以下を適用する。(1) 今回の審査対象企業は最終結果の税率。(2) 表にない、調査・審査済みで個別税率を持つ中国内外の輸出業者は、該当業者について直近の手続で公表した固有税率を維持。(3) 個別税率を認められない中国の輸出業者は中国全体の251.64％［6］。(4) 固有の個別税率を持たない中国外の輸出業者には、当該業者に供給した中国輸出業者の税率。適用した保証金要件は別途通知まで有効。
［6］命令、85 FR 22132頁参照。

輸入業者への通知。19 CFR 351.402(f)(2)に基づき、審査期間中の該当申告の精算前に反ダンピング税・相殺関税の補填に関する証明書を提出する責任を最終通知する。従わなければ補填があったと推定され、反ダンピング税が倍額になり、または相殺関税額に応じて反ダンピング税が増額され得る。

行政保護命令（APO）。19 CFR 351.305(a)(3)に従い、APOで開示された専有情報の返却・破棄の責任を最終通知する。本手続の営業秘密情報に同条が引き続き適用される。返却・破棄または司法保護命令への移行を速やかに書面で通知することを求める。不履行は制裁の対象となる違反。

利害関係者への通知。関税法第751条(a)(1)・第777条(i)(1)と19 CFR 351.221(b)(5)に従い発出・掲載する。2026年11月6日付。政策・交渉担当執行部長 スティーブン・プレシング。
